trips.overview:
Goa is India's smallest state by area and one of its favourite escapes, loved for its beaches, nightlife and Portuguese heritage. More than 450 years as a Portuguese colony shows in its churches, food and easy-going vibe, including the UNESCO World Heritage churches of Old Goa like the Basilica of Bom Jesus and Se Cathedral. The coastline has something for every mood, from lively Baga, Calangute and Anjuna to calmer Palolem, Agonda and Morjim.

This **4 Nights / 5 Days** backpacking trip is a road trip in AC vehicles from Pune, Bangalore or Hyderabad. Once you arrive, it is "Goa with strangers" who quickly become friends, then an offbeat plus market day, a "not so offbeat" day, and a run down South before your last moments by the sea. Along the way you hike to Cabo de Rama beach, go kayaking, watch the sunset at Dona Paula, hike to the lake at Arambol beach for a dip and some local market shopping, and have the option of a casino or Tito's Lane evening (entry at your own cost).

You stay 4 nights in a 3 to 4 star resort with a pool party, and get 4 breakfasts, 1 lunch and 1 dinner, local sightseeing, all internal travel within Goa with fuel and driver, Trip Captains, and 24x7 travel assistance.

Later on, we will cover the Goa local market, do some shopping, buy hippy stuff, and later regret it.

Relax for a while near the beach, as the day is about to end, and now you have 3 options:
Option 1: Dance like anything in a nearby shack in Arambol beach.
Option 2: Let's decorate our picnic spot right in front of the sea (a bedsheet, some scented candles, give an aesthetic vibe), look at the stars, talk about lives, or just stay quiet and hear the sea talk.

We will plan according to the vibe and mood of the group, or what if we can tick both out of our bucket list.

Back to the hotel.

trips.overview:
Auli sits in Uttarakhand's Chamoli district and is India's best-known skiing destination, with wide open slopes and big panoramic views of the Himalayas, including Nanda Devi. The meadows sit at roughly 2,500m to 3,050m, skiing season runs from January to March, and the famous cable car makes it a popular hill station all year round.

This is a **2 Nights / 3 Days** group trip with transfers in an AC traveller or bus on the Delhi, Govindghat, Joshimath, Delhi route. Day 1 is the drive to Govindghat, where you stay both nights in a hotel. Day 2 is the big one: a day visit to Auli for snow fun and skiing, plus the trek to Gorson Bugyal, the beautiful high meadow above Auli. You can also check out Auli Artificial Lake and end the evening around a bonfire. Day 3 is departure.

You get 2 breakfasts and 2 dinners, a Trip Coordinator with you throughout, and 24x7 customer support. Just note that the ropeway (cable car or chair car) to Auli is not included, so keep some budget aside if you want to ride it.

trips.overview:
This 6 Nights / 7 Days Leh to Leh trip is a splendid blend of adventure, serenity and culture, set against Ladakh's breathtaking scenery. You arrive in Leh, take a day to acclimatise, explore Leh on a local sightseeing day, then head out to **Nubra Valley**, **Turtuk** and **Pangong Lake** before the trip wraps up with a drop to Leh airport.

In Nubra you'll see Diskit Monastery and the Hunder sand dunes with their Bactrian camels. **Turtuk**, one of India's northernmost villages and formerly part of Pakistan, gives you a glimpse into Balti culture: lush green apricot fields, rustic wooden homes and friendly smiles, a striking contrast to Ladakh's arid mountains. Nearby, the Thang border viewpoint is another highlight.

Choose how you ride: a **sitting coach**, or a **Royal Enfield Himalayan** solo or with a pillion. The biking option includes bike rent for 5 days, fuel as per itinerary, riding gear, an RE mechanic with spares and a mechanical and luggage backup vehicle. Everyone gets 6 nights of stay across hotels, camps or cottages and homestays, all inner line permits, a complimentary bonfire night and a Team Captain throughout.

En route, we will be traversing through one of the Highest Motorable Roads in the World, Khardung La (18,380 Ft) which offers magnificent views of towering mountains.
Upon reaching Nubra Valley, travelers can indulge in a Double Hump Bactrian Camel Ride, ATV rides, and more. (on personal expense)
After indulging in thrill filled activities, travelers will check-in to their campsites.
Dinner will be served followed by an overnight stay in Nubra Valley.

itinerary.title: NUBRA TO TURTUK (170 KMS)

Rise and Shine! Today, we'll be heading out to Turtuk which is the last village of India on the Indo-Pak border renowned for its apricots.
Upon our arrival in Turtuk, we’ll spend some time exploring the beautiful village on foot.
Sun bask by Shyok River, explore the nearby Balti Museum and relish in surreal views.
We'll head back to Nubra by the evening where we'll have dinner followed by an overnight stay.

itinerary.title: NUBRA VALLEY TO PANGONG (180 KMS)

It's Pangong Day! Post-breakfast, we’ll check out from our campsite and head towards Pangong Lake.
En-route, we will visit the Diskit Monastery, popular for the 100ft tall colorful statue of Buddha.
After paying our reverence at the monastery, we will resume our journey towards Pangong, the iconic lake that has gained popularity ever since featuring in the Bollywood blockbuster movies like 3 Idiots and Jab tak hai Jaan.

We will also pay our respects at Thiksey Monastery, which is the largest Monastery in Central Ladakh.
Upon reaching Leh, we will check into our designated hotel where we will have dinner and spend the night.

The group will disband and go their separate ways, to their respective cities according to their own scheduled departure.

trips.overview:
Jaisalmer, the "Golden City" of Rajasthan, is a magical mix of history and desert adventure, best visited between October and March. At its heart is the 12th-century Jaisalmer Fort (Sonar Quila), a UNESCO World Heritage site and one of the few living forts in the world, surrounded by ornately carved havelis and golden sandstone lanes.

This **2 Nights / 3 Days** group trip covers all travel as per the itinerary in a tempo traveller or mini bus. Day 1 you reach Jaisalmer and set off on a city tour: think the fort, Patwon-ki-Haveli, Nathmal-ki-Haveli, Salim Singh-ki-Haveli and an easy evening at Gadisar Lake. Day 2 takes you to the Longewala battlefield, with offbeat stops like Kuldhara abandoned village, Bada Bagh cenotaphs and the War Museum among the trip highlights. Out at the Sam Sand Dunes you get jeep dune bashing, a camel safari and that famous desert sunset, followed by a night in Swiss tents with a bonfire and Rajasthani folk music and dance. Day 3 wraps up the city tour before departure.

You stay 2 nights on a sharing basis in a hotel and Swiss tents, with 4 meals (2 breakfasts, 2 dinners), local sightseeing, an experienced trip leader, 24x7 onboard assistance, and driver allowances, tolls, parking and state taxes covered.

Upon reaching Jaisalmer, Get ready for a Guided tour of Jaisalmer - Golden City.
Visit the golden Jaisalmer Fort that looks like it has just risen from the sands with its golden limestone walls and ancient havelis of Jaisalmer.
Take a short stopover at the beautiful Gadisar Lake that was once the only source of water in Jaisalmer.
Overnight stay at Hotel in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.content:
Wake up at your hotel to a beautiful morning and enjoy a delicious breakfast.
Later, get ready to visit the border town of Longewala, the spot for Indo- Pak war of 1971. Longewala is a place of historical significance that serves as a reminder of the bravery and sacrifice of Indian soldiers during a critical moment in the nation's history.
In the evening, enjoy folk performances by the locals while enjoying a bonfire. Have your wholesome Rajasthani meal with the fellow travelers. Overnight stay at the Desert Camp in Jaisalmer.

itinerary.content:
Wake up in the morning, enjoy a hearty breakfast and check out from the campsite.
Later get ready for Camel ride on Sam Sand Dunes & Jeep Safari and you can experience the spectacular view of Sunrise in Thar desert.
Post lunch, get ready to get chills in bone as you explore abandoned village of Kuldhara.
Later, depart for Delhi around 4-5PM. Reach Delhi the next morning with beautiful trip memories.

highlights: Jaisalmer Fort (Sonar Quila): A UNESCO World Heritage site, one of the few living forts in the world.
Sam Sand Dunes: Famous for camel/jeep safaris, dune bashing, and watching the sunset.

Royal palaces, shimmering lakes and one of Rajasthan's mightiest forts: this **2 Nights / 3 Days** weekend getaway is a proper slice of Mewar history set in the Aravalli hills. Day 1 you reach Udaipur and kick off with a city tour. trips.overview:
Beaches, islands, a full moon party and a whole lot of sea spray: this **6 Nights / 7 Days** Thailand group trip packs the best of the south into one week. You arrive in Phuket, Thailand's largest island, nestled in the Andaman Sea, and head straight to Krabi for a 4 Island tour by speedboat.

From there it's over to Koh Samui to explore the island, a trip across to Koh Phangan for the famous full moon party, and a leisure day to just slow down. Then you're back in Phuket for a city walk and pub crawl, followed by a speedboat day trip to Phi Phi Island, the place that shared the screen with Leonardo DiCaprio in The Beach. Think limestone karsts rising out of the sea, lush green cover and waves breaking over coral reefs. Phuket's Sino-colonial buildings, Big Buddha and Wat Chalong give you a glimpse of its eclectic culture too.

We take care of airport pick-up and drop at the destination city, 6 nights of accommodation, 6 breakfasts and 2 lunches (on the Phi Phi and Krabi island tours), plus all the ferries, speedboats and transfers between Krabi, Koh Samui, Koh Phangan and Phuket. 5% GST and 5% TCS are already included.

trips.overview:
From buzzing city nights to misty limestone bays, this **7 Nights / 8 Days** Vietnam group trip runs the length of the country. Vietnam stretches along the eastern coast of the Indochina Peninsula, bordering China, Laos and Cambodia, with a long coastline on the South China Sea, and its mix of history, culture and landscapes is hard to beat.

You start in Ho Chi Minh City (formerly Saigon), the economic hub of French colonial landmarks and modern skyscrapers, with a city stroll and nightlife. Next comes a full-day Cu Chi Tunnels tour with the War Remnants Museum. Then it's Da Nang for beach time and the Dragon Bridge, a Ba Na Hills day with the cable car, Golden Hand Bridge and French Village, and a bamboo basket boat ride plus a Hoi An Ancient Town tour with a lantern boat ride.

The north brings Hanoi, the capital known for its centuries-old architecture, lakes and street food, where you explore the Old Quarter, catch the buzz of Train Street and party on Beer Street. The grand finale is a Ha Long Bay cruise with kayaking, cave exploration and an overnight stay among the emerald waters and limestone cliffs, before departure day.

trips.overview:
In winter, Spiti Valley turns this high-altitude cold desert in Himachal Pradesh into a silent, snow-covered wonderland. Temperatures can plunge to -20°C or lower, rivers freeze, ancient monasteries like Key and Tabo sit under snow, and it's the best season for a chance to spot the elusive snow leopard. This **6 Nights / 7 Days** backpacking trip is for travellers who want the real, raw winter experience.

With the Manali route closed in winter, you travel via Shimla through Kinnaur. The journey starts with an AC bus from Delhi to Shimla, then heads to Sangla and Chitkul, on through Khab to Nako, across Chicham Bridge to Key Monastery, up to Hikkim, Komic and Langza, and back via Kaza to Kalpa before the return from Shimla to Delhi. Expect frozen waterfalls, snowy monasteries and serious stargazing.

We cover the AC bus between Delhi and Shimla, all sightseeing by tempo traveller, 6 nights of stay, 12 meals, all inner line permits, a team captain throughout, an oxygen cylinder in the tempo traveller, and driver charges, tolls, parking and fuel. Most hotels shut in the cold, so stays are mostly village homestays with basic, hearty local food and limited water. Pack warm and come with an adventurous spirit.
